# Custom Modules & Code Areas — Secomm Launchpad

## Repository Structure

- **Branch strategy**: development (active), master, development_fashion (remote-only)
- **Monorepo**: false
- **Repo URL**: `git@bitbucket.org:secomm-vn/slaunchpad.git`
- **Local dev**: local LAMP-style checkout (MAGE_MODE=developer, MySQL 127.0.0.1, file cache + file sessions). [TBD: no docker-compose committed]
- **Test commands**: `vendor/bin/phpunit`

## Key Directories

| Directory | Purpose | Risk Level |
|-----------|---------|------------|
| `app/code/Secomm/` | Secomm_Base, Secomm_AddressDropdown, Secomm_VietNamAddress | medium (AddressDropdown) |
| `app/code/Mageplaza/` | 16 Mageplaza modules (source-committed, not composer) | medium |
| `app/code/Vnpayment/` | Vnpayment_VNPAY payment gateway | high |
| `app/design/frontend/Secomm/launchpad/` | primary Hyvä child theme (web/tailwind toolchain) | medium |
| `app/design/frontend/Secomm/launchpad_fashion/` | fashion variant (grandchild, scaffolded) | low |
| `app/etc/` | env.php (local dev), config.php, hyva-themes.json | high (secrets/env) |

## Common Development Areas

Areas developers work on frequently:

- Theme customization in `app/design/frontend/Secomm/launchpad/` (Tailwind v4 `tailwind-source.css`, `.phtml` templates, Alpine.js + Magewire components)
- Vietnam address dropdown logic (Secomm_AddressDropdown GraphQL surface + admin CRUD/import-export)
- Checkout flow customization (Mageplaza OSC, ExtraFee, DeliveryTime) — extend via plugin/preference, never edit Mageplaza in place
- Payment integration (VNPAY controllers/IPN/signature; Mollie config)
- Translation dictionaries (`vi_VN.csv` + `en_US.csv`) for any new storefront string

## Areas to Avoid Without TL Approval

- `app/code/Vnpayment/VNPAY` (payment/IPN/signature) — requires SA review (Tier 2 escalation). High risk: custom payment gateway, signature/IPN validation, PCI-sensitive.
- Mageplaza OSC checkout flow (any change) — requires end-to-end checkout QC + payment test.
- `app/code/Mageplaza/*` — third-party source; do NOT modify in place — extend via plugin/preference only.
- Address-related changes (Secomm_AddressDropdown + VietNamAddress) — must validate the VN hierarchical dropdown (country→state→city→sub-city) end-to-end.
- `app/etc/env.php` — do NOT commit production env.php / Redis / OpenSearch credentials; local-dev config only in repo.
- Database schema changes — Tier 2 escalation.
